Unit tests for sysvar map lookup, cache lifecycle, and sysvar read and restore logic.

# Purpose
This file contains unit tests for the `fd_sysvar_cache` code. It checks the sysvar map, cache object life cycle, validation state, data query functions, and typed read accessors for several Solana system variables such as `clock`, `epoch_rewards`, `epoch_schedule`, `last_restart_slot`, `rent`, `slot_hashes`, `slot_history`, and `stake_history`. The tests also verify error handling for invalid pointers, bad alignment, bad magic values, and empty cache state.

The file also defines helper code to build and destroy a test environment with `fd_funk`, `fd_accdb`, and `fd_bank` objects, and it includes [`sysvar_inject`](<#sysvar_inject>), which writes serialized sysvar data directly into the cache for test use. The [`test_sysvar_cache_read`](<#test_sysvar_cache_read>) test uses this helper to restore a real `clock` sysvar record, confirm that the cache reports it as valid, and check that the decoded fields match the expected values.
